newsitem.title: USA: KVH trims 97 domestic Tracphone shipments.
newsitem.headline: KVH trims 97 domestic Tracphone shipments.

text.p: KVH Industries Inc said it anticipates 1997 domestic shipments of its Tracphone satellite telephone product will fall short of earlier expectations.
The company said the reduction is expected Tracphone shipments is a result of lower-than-anticipated initial sales of the Tracphone to end-users during the first 90 days of availability.
Tracphone is supplied to American Mobile Satellite Corp for use with its Skycell mobile communications service.
